title: Six narratives about the true value of open repositories
what_changed: COAR published its "New Narratives Series for Repositories", arguing repository value across six areas, starting with the public value of repositories (access for physicians, educators, entrepreneurs outside the academy), digital sovereignty and local stewardship (distributed, institution-governed infrastructure with no single point of failure), and multilingual scholarship (repositories as a foundation for a multilingual scholarly commons).
why_it_matters: Repositories are usually described as background utilities; the series reframes them as infrastructure answering geopolitical, AI and integrity pressures, which matters for how institutions and funders justify repository investment.
